defects.detail: every defect on its rung, every core defect in a feature; no promise for a type or analyzer defect

features_core.detail: every feature rests on answered questions, schema nodes and checked invariants

fluent.detail: one concept per name, every Q7 cell compiles, is refused as named or waits on a door the spec marks new, one shape per name, callbacks named as the locked table names them, every string parameter of a closed kind

history.detail: every regression SHA on its branch and tied to a spec line

inventory.detail: every door, kind, analyzer and case row equals its source line by line, and every test count its attributes

main_surface.detail: main's surface written for every package and target framework

matrix.detail: MultiSelect covers 60 of 103 cells from its .d.ts and tests 19 of them as its own; ConformanceComponent runs 101 of 103, and FusionMultiSelect carries the other 2

module_cites.detail: every cite a module.md makes resolves at the SHA it names, or at HEAD, the redesign or main, and a package's in the installed node_modules

names.detail: each of the module table's 20 core modules is a folder of section 2.1's Alis.Reactive/ and in one of 16 SliceTree rows, each of its 26 modules a folder of section 2.1's projects and spec/<Module>/module.md; each of 14 TLA+ specs in section 2.6 sits at spec/<Owner>/ and TLC runs it; each of spec/'s 40 entries is a module folder or named by section 2.1's spec line

native_behaviors.detail: 25 behaviors on 9 declarations of native.json, each naming tests of the spec

no_comments.detail: no comment in the spec's Python or TLA+

packages.detail: section 2.9 packs 6 ids, main's but Alis.Reactive.FluentValidator and the decided Alis.Reactive.OpenTelemetry; each ships only bundles, each dependency and each of 19 references the kept projects take is pinned in section 2.7 at its version

paths.detail: each of 174 paths at HEAD and main's tip, down to tests, tools, build, examples, scripts, .github and .claude's folders, is kept by section 2 or retired by section 3, never both

plants.detail: 245 refused plants caught and 85 accepted plants kept green; 39 of 39 checks proven both ways

probes.detail: every fact printed by its probe or found at its source line, every browser fact with the proof the rewrite ships

promises.detail: every refusal and behavior defect, every cell the native reference runs and each cell MultiSelect tests as its own, has a promise

questions.detail: every question answered with resolving evidence, checker and rungs

rewrite_cites.detail: each of 6 cites REWRITE.md makes names its SHA and resolves there

slice_tests.detail: 67 rendered slices each with a placed behavior test; M21.F2, M25.F6, M24.F1 are the bases slices declare on and render nothing

survival.detail: brief, notes, map, check, hook and branch in place

test_rules.detail: tests.md's 10 rules and 13 smells each held in REWRITE.md by test rules TEST001 to TEST013 or a named check, every test rule holding one

tlc.detail: every spec green, every invariant killed by its mutant, every witness reached
